source_sql: CREATE TABLE t(id INT(11) AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, amt DECIMAL(20,4))
gold_target_sql: CREATE TABLE t(id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, amt NUMERIC(20,4))

source_sql: SELECT dept, GROUP_CONCAT(name SEPARATOR ',') FROM emp GROUP BY dept
gold_target_sql: SELECT dept, STRING_AGG(name, ',') FROM emp GROUP BY dept

source_sql: CREATE TABLE t(id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY)
gold_target_sql: CREATE TABLE t(id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY)

source_sql: SELECT YEAR(hire_date) AS y, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY YEAR(hire_date)
gold_target_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) AS y, COUNT(*) FROM emp GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date)

source_sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE name REGEXP '^a'
gold_target_sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE name ~ '^a'

source_sql: SELECT NVL2(commission, salary+commission, salary) AS total FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN commission IS NOT NULL THEN salary+commission ELSE salary END AS total FROM emp
gold_report_points: NVL2(a,b,c) → CASE WHEN a IS NOT NULL THEN b ELSE c END

source_sql: SELECT name, salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT name, salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rnk FROM emp
gold_report_points: RANK 窗口函数两端兼容

source_sql: SELECT e.name,d.dname FROM emp e,dept d WHERE e.dept_id=d.id(+)
gold_target_sql: SELECT e.name,d.dname FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id=d.id
gold_report_points: 逗号连接改为显式 JOIN
